note: Curated catalog of public skill repos worth consuming into an AOS. Human guide: ../skill-repo-catalog.md. Full generated skill index: skills-index.json (npm run catalog:skills). Entries are advisory — the consume-skill-repo scan and per-folder license check remain mandatory.

repos.description: Jesse Vincent's superpowers — core engineering process skills (debugging, TDD, planning, verification).
MicrosoftDocs curated Agent Skills — roughly one skill per Microsoft/Azure service.
gotchas: ~190 skills — never enable broadly; search skills-index.json and enable only the services you actually use.

repos.description: Anthropic's official skills repo — document skills (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx) plus example skills like mcp-builder and skill-creator.
gotchas: License varies PER SKILL FOLDER — check before enabling.
Document skills are source-available: consume-in-place only, never republish.

repos.description: Anthropic's knowledge-work plugins — business-function skill bundles (finance, sales, productivity, customer-support, data, legal, marketing...). The finance plugin speaks the FP&A language: close, reconciliation, variance, journal entries, SOX.
gotchas: Marketplace shape: plugins sit at the repo ROOT, each with its own skills/ — the skillsRoot above pins the finance plugin. To consume another plugin (e.g. sales, productivity), register a separate entry with skillsRoot '<plugin>/skills'.
Skills reference MCP connectors (Snowflake, HubSpot, ...) the operator must wire up or mentally swap for their own stack.
The repo's example content (small-business, partner-built plugins) contains fictional personas whose emails trip secrets scanners — known false positives; the finance plugin scans clean.

repos.description: Anthropic's Claude for Financial Services — the finance-skills benchmark: financial modeling (DCF, comps, LBO, 3-statement), Excel audit, deck QC, GL reconciliation, month-end close agents, plus partner-built LSEG and S&P Global verticals.
gotchas: Marketplace shape: skills live under plugins/vertical-plugins/<vertical>/skills — the skillsRoot above pins the core financial-analysis vertical; browse the other verticals (investment-banking, equity-research, private-equity, fund-admin, operations) and register the ones you need.
Many skills assume paid market-data MCP connectors (FactSet, Morningstar, PitchBook...) — the modeling/Excel skills work without them.
Output is draft analyst work product for qualified-professional review — mirror that disclaimer to clients.

repos.description: Trail of Bits security skills — professional audit methodology from a premier security firm: code review (C/C++, Rust), semgrep rule authoring, supply-chain risk, and agentic-actions-auditor (AI-agent injection vectors in CI workflows).
gotchas: Marketplace shape: ~40 plugins each with their own plugins/<plugin>/skills root — the skillsRoot above is one example; browse plugins/ and register entries for the plugins you need (agentic-actions-auditor is the standout for MCP/agent builders).
CC-BY-SA-4.0, not MIT/Apache: share-alike — derivative skill docs must carry the same license.
Smart-contract plugins (building-secure-contracts) are out of scope for most adopters — skip them.

repos.description: Vercel Labs agent skills — engineering-derived rulebooks: react-best-practices (40+ performance rules), web-design-guidelines (100+ accessibility/UX checks), writing-guidelines (docs quality).
gotchas: Cherry-pick: the Vercel deploy/optimize skills only matter on Vercel's platform — the three recommended skills are platform-neutral.

repos.description: HubSpot admin skills (37) with unusually strong safety engineering: portal-wide audit, contact enrichment/assignment, workflows-as-code export, and a sandbox self-test harness. Account-type checks fail closed.
gotchas: Most skills bundle executable Python scripts — review them per skill before enabling (they are transparent, but they are code).
Needs a HubSpot private-app token; test in a sandbox portal first (the repo's own guidance).
Community-maintained (single author, active) — re-check health before broad rollout.
